entries.explanation: The selected partial file cannot be written under its explicit reference and pointer policies.
likely_causes: An unselected ID, missing or ambiguous pointer, unknown raw pointer role, or unsupported embedded-ID promotion
next_steps: Inspect every refusal site and target. Keep the source unchanged; select dependencies explicitly or review a typed clear policy. Never bypass an unknown pointer refusal.

entries.explanation: The saved compositor graph contains a cycle unsupported by this structural profile.
likely_causes: Cyclic links in the saved or requested graph
next_steps: Inspect the graph in compatible Blender; do not bypass the refusal.

entries.explanation: A node, socket or link endpoint does not resolve to exactly one valid tree member.
likely_causes: Missing or duplicate names, wrong direction, dangling links or wrong socket ownership
next_steps: Inspect this exact file with node-tree inspect and use its exact node names and socket identifiers.

entries.explanation: The saved graph or node type differs from the explicitly expected graph.
likely_causes: A stale specification or a different input save
next_steps: Inspect this exact input and review the intended change before preparing a new expected graph.

entries.explanation: The saved compositor structure is outside the supported checked graph profile.
likely_causes: Unsupported topology, ambiguous ownership or invalid serialized structure
next_steps: Keep the original untouched; inspect the refusal and use compatible Blender for unsupported edits.

entries.explanation: The target input already has a guarded existing link.
likely_causes: An add-link operation targets an occupied input
next_steps: Explicitly remove or relink the expected existing link before adding a replacement.

entries.explanation: Endpoint socket types differ from their exact expected types or from each other.
likely_causes: A stale endpoint description or an implicit socket conversion
next_steps: Use exact inspected types; implicit conversions are not supported.

entries.explanation: The input does not match the supported native Blender structural profile.
likely_causes: A different build, format, pointer width, byte order or subversion
next_steps: Use a known-good save from Blender 5.2.1 build 9e2066aef7ef, subversion 44; do not patch the version to bypass validation.

entries.explanation: More than one saved data-block matches the requested linked ID identity.
likely_causes: Duplicate type/name identities in the library
Library identity reconstruction cannot choose uniquely
next_steps: Inspect the library's saved ID code/name and owner chain
Check duplicates in Blender on a copy
Do not choose the first candidate just to make traversal complete.

entries.explanation: A saved address does not identify one unique target in the applicable namespace.
likely_causes: Repeated old addresses in ID/global or qualified cross-owner maps
A duplicate within one owner DATA run instead has duplicate_data_address; namespace context matters
next_steps: Keep the source block and address with the diagnostic
Inspect exact-file blocks and pointer-census candidates
Do not resolve ambiguity by block order.

entries.explanation: A selected block, record element or array index lies outside its checked extent.
likely_causes: An index copied from another save
An array element beyond its declared count
An internally calculated edit range beyond the body
next_steps: Use inspect on this exact input and confirm block/count/array dimensions
Correct the selection rather than clipping the index
Do not reuse physical indices across saves.

entries.explanation: The consumer closed stdout or another output pipe before Oxblend delivered everything.
likely_causes: Piping to head or another early-exiting filter
next_steps: Capture complete stdout and stderr to files and retain Oxblend's producer exit
Inspect any edit/pack destination before another run because publication may already have happened
Do not treat a surviving prefix or the last pipeline process's exit as success.

entries.explanation: A graph operation cannot prove that every included direct-data allocation has an included owner.
likely_causes: Closure selection omitted an owning ID
next_steps: Inspect selected roots and their owner-local DATA runs
Keep owner and owned records together in a qualified graph operation
Do not transplant detached DATA or bypass ownership checks.

entries.explanation: The input container could not be decompressed as the expected blend byte stream.
next_steps: Retain the original compressed bytes and complete decoder message
Verify the input copy/hash and try opening a copy in compatible Blender
Do not repair compressed bytes by hand or label every decoder refusal an Oxblend bug.

entries.explanation: Packing derived different replacement paths for the same saved owning field.
likely_causes: Shared path field reached by usages with incompatible destinations
next_steps: Compare the affected usages and planned destinations in a dry-run
Choose a consistent project layout or isolate the requests
Do not arbitrarily keep one rewrite and discard the other.

entries.explanation: The source file's DNA has no structure required by an internal graph constructor.
likely_causes: Requested constructor type absent from the saved schema
Constructor kit and requested operation differ
next_steps: Inspect the source schema and constructor requirements
Use Blender to create the requested structure if no qualified constructor applies
Do not invent a structure layout or add a type by patching DNA.

entries.explanation: The planned Cryptomatte Scene-to-Image replacement cannot find its required imported records.
likely_causes: The source Cryptomatte node was excluded from the closure
next_steps: Check the import plan's node and Image selections together
Rebuild the plan from the current graph
Do not publish a graph with an unresolved Cryptomatte retarget.

entries.explanation: A supposedly released Scene is still reachable through a kept graph edge.
likely_causes: Another retained node or record still points to the original Scene
next_steps: Inspect the reported block and edge before removing the Scene
Change the intended closure or use Blender to perform the conversion
Do not delete a Scene while kept references still reach it.

entries.explanation: The Cryptomatte node does not point to the Scene named by the conversion plan.
next_steps: Read the node's actual saved ID and compare it with the planned Scene
Regenerate the plan from this input
Do not retarget an unrelated Scene's Cryptomatte source.

entries.explanation: A graph name or string cannot be stored as a bounded NUL-terminated string in the selected field.
likely_causes: Name plus terminator exceeds field capacity
An embedded NUL appears in the supplied string
next_steps: Check the actual saved field capacity and shorten the value intentionally
Remove unintended embedded NUL bytes
Do not truncate names automatically because links or identity may depend on them.

entries.explanation: Traversal encountered a repeated active reference in a chain that must terminate.
likely_causes: Malformed chain or unsupported traversal interpretation
next_steps: Keep the owner and chain reported by trace or overrides
Inspect the corresponding references in Blender on a copy
Do not assume this means a node feedback loop or remove arbitrary links.

entries.explanation: A nonzero saved pointer has no resolvable target in its checked namespace.
likely_causes: Native load-time library compatibility not covered by a narrow profile
next_steps: Retain owner file, source block, field and pointer address
Use trace for dependency questions and compare native behavior on a copy
Do not zero arbitrary pointers or generalize narrow linked-library compatibility to every dangling slot.

entries.explanation: Staged typed-edit output differs outside the declared fixed-width changes or changed length.
likely_causes: Concurrent or storage corruption affecting staged data
next_steps: Keep the spec, input hash and full error without publishing the suspect stage
Compare decoded bytes against declared edit ranges if diagnosing
Do not accept the output merely because Blender opens it.

entries.explanation: An internally emitted graph failed its decoded-byte readback check.
next_steps: Retain the operation plan and source schema plus the exact mismatch
Report a reproducible minimized case after checking storage errors
Do not deliver the output as verified.

entries.explanation: A semantic comparison field would extend beyond its allocation.
likely_causes: Comparison interpretation does not match the source layout
next_steps: Inspect the named allocation and source SDNA on both inputs
Treat the comparison as incomplete
Do not interpret zero reported differences as equality.

entries.explanation: The comparison could not assign unique stable identities to all required allocations.
next_steps: Inspect the reported allocations and unresolved identity details
Use exact byte comparison only for its narrower byte-equality question
Do not turn equal:null into equal:false or a semantic verdict.

entries.explanation: A pointer-array allocation's byte extent is not a multiple of pointer width.
likely_causes: The allocation was interpreted as the wrong role
next_steps: Check pointer width, allocation size and owning field in inspect
Keep both input hashes and the incomplete diff
Do not discard trailing bytes to force an array interpretation.

entries.explanation: The same native ID address occurs more than once in a namespace that requires uniqueness.
next_steps: Inspect all blocks at the reported address and their ID codes
Keep the unmodified file for triage
Do not select one duplicate by order or rewrite addresses manually.

entries.explanation: The requested persistence policy is invalid, unsupported here, or could not complete filesystem synchronization.
likely_causes: end syncfs on an unsupported platform
next_steps: Check the exact policy and underlying operating-system message
Inspect output_written/archive_written and durability_completed before retrying
Do not assume a published output was rolled back or is crash-durable.

entries.explanation: Two edits overlap or are ordered incompatibly in the same decoded bytes.
likely_causes: Path rewrite overlaps a qualified library-pointer clear
next_steps: Combine intended changes into one nonoverlapping plan based on current bytes
Inspect reported offsets before retrying to a fresh output
Do not apply competing expected-old changes sequentially to evade the conflict.

entries.explanation: The edit/rewrite input is not the strict schema expected by that command.
likely_causes: Unknown keys or ambiguous path/value objects
next_steps: Compare with USAGE's schema-1 rewrite or schema-2 edit contract as applicable
Correct the spec without weakening its expected-old guards
Do not copy generic get output directly as a typed-edit input value.

entries.explanation: Typed editing is not admitted for this header version or endianness.
next_steps: Use compatible Blender to make the change or explicitly save a separate suitable file
Read the qualified profile requirements before retrying
Do not patch the version/endian marker to gain admission.

entries.explanation: Path rewriting was asked to clear a reference rather than relocate it.
next_steps: Choose a real replacement path if relocation was intended
Use Blender for clearing/removing the reference
Do not treat an empty path as an ordinary successful repath.

entries.explanation: A value required as text is not valid UTF-8.
next_steps: Use inspect/get byte hex where available and preserve the original bytes
For summary name failures use inspect and blocks rather than repeated summary
Do not replace invalid bytes and then use that display text as identity.

entries.explanation: The exact saved old value or qualified pointer-clear site no longer matches the plan.
likely_causes: Plan from another input or snapshot
next_steps: Read the current value/site from the exact input and review whether the intended change still applies
Regenerate the guarded plan deliberately
Do not overwrite the expected value blindly to silence the refusal.

entries.explanation: The saved filepath differs byte-for-byte from the rewrite's expected old path.
next_steps: Get the path from this exact input and compare authoritative hex
Rebuild the request only after confirming the intended owner
Do not drop the old-path guard or normalize away meaningful bytes.

entries.explanation: EXR pixel decoding could not complete under the selected saved structure and codec contract.
likely_causes: The selected data is truncated or inconsistent
A codec decode failed; a valid header alone does not prove its pixel payload
next_steps: Retain the exact decode error and exr-header inventory
Check this input's selected part, dimensions, channels and compression against the supported pixel profile
Do not invent pixels or treat metadata-only inspection as a decode proof

entries.explanation: The EXR header is malformed or incomplete for header parsing.
next_steps: Keep the exact EXR and parser message and verify the transfer
Check the file with an independent EXR-capable reader if available
Do not infer pixel integrity from header parsing or repair attribute bytes speculatively.

entries.explanation: The available bytes end before a complete required EXR header or structural record can be read.
likely_causes: A partial, truncated or still-changing input
Bytes that do not contain a complete supported EXR structure
next_steps: Preserve the original and check the actual input size/completeness
Retain independent scan results, but do not claim the truncated member is complete
Obtain a complete source or compatible re-export; do not pad or invent missing header data

entries.explanation: The requested EXR part or channel selection is absent or cannot be represented by the selected output contract.
likely_causes: A missing part index or channel name
A selection unavailable as an exact supported channel set
next_steps: Inspect exr-header for this exact input's parts and channel names
Select exact saved parts and channels with supported names/types
Do not substitute similarly named channels or inferred defaults

entries.explanation: This EXR version, flag set or pass interpretation has no qualified support.
likely_causes: Multipart/deep/multiview or sampled channels outside a pass profile
next_steps: Separate raw header metadata from supported compositor pass interpretation
Use an EXR/native tool for the unsupported operation
Do not flatten views/parts or guess pass meaning to make the profile fit.

entries.explanation: The selected typed-edit field is not inside a qualified editable owner run.
next_steps: Select the actual ID-owned saved field using inspect
Use Blender for changes outside admitted owners
Do not edit DNA/control metadata as though it were scene data.

entries.explanation: A graph field path requires an embedded structure but the selected field is not one.
next_steps: Inspect the source DNA field type and correct the path
Resolve pointer targets explicitly when applicable
Do not reinterpret pointer or primitive storage as an embedded structure.

entries.explanation: Internal graph editing requires a qualified little-endian source layout.
likely_causes: Owner layout not admitted for graph writes
next_steps: Use Blender for the requested structural operation
Keep read-only diagnosis separate from write admission
Do not change endian/header bytes or bypass owner validation.

entries.explanation: A masked integer edit sets and clears the same bit or uses bits outside the field width.
likely_causes: Mask too wide for the saved scalar
next_steps: Derive masks from the actual scalar width and desired flags
Make set and clear disjoint
Do not truncate masks or assume all integer fields are 32-bit.

entries.explanation: A new node identifier cannot fit the required positive signed storage.
likely_causes: Existing identifiers leave no representable next identifier
next_steps: Inspect the node tree's identifiers and use Blender to reconstruct safely if needed
Keep the overflowing identifier evidence
Do not wrap/reuse an existing identifier.

entries.explanation: A guarded same-allocation IDProperty UTF-8 string value edit could not be proved.
likely_causes: Old length, capacity, owner or pointer-alias admission failed
Replacement plus NUL exceeds the existing allocation; the message reports its byte limit
next_steps: Inspect exact saved IDProperty fields and raw payload with get/pointer/payload
Supply the exact name/value guard and a replacement that fits; do not patch pointers or allocation bytes
Use native Blender for a change requiring allocation growth or structural mutation

entries.explanation: The comparison finished without enough evidence for an equality claim.
next_steps: Read equal, complete, unresolved records and differences separately
Use a native visual/evaluation comparison for that different question
Do not call equal:null equal or different even when difference_count is zero.

entries.explanation: The edit report is incomplete; the specific cause is in its errors and publication state.
next_steps: Read every report error and output_written/durability_completed before choosing a fix
Preserve any already-published result and choose a fresh destination if rerunning
Do not assume this wrapper means no bytes reached disk.

entries.explanation: The EXR scan retained independent observations but could not establish every requested member or qualification.
likely_causes: One or more inputs or members failed inspection
A saved structure or requested decode is unsupported or unavailable
next_steps: Retain JSON stdout despite the nonzero exit and inspect each nested error/status
Keep metadata coverage separate from full pixel decoding and render correctness
Resolve unavailable members without dropping or substituting them to claim completeness

entries.explanation: Independent saved facts were retained but one or more required queries failed.
likely_causes: A pointer, layout or source read could not be proved
next_steps: Inspect each nested error and owner/field site
Do not treat retained independent facts as complete

entries.explanation: The override report has unresolved or refused records and is not a complete inventory.
next_steps: Read the report's per-owner errors and reader_kind where present
Use --non-strict only to gather more diagnostics, not to certify completeness
Do not treat successfully serialized JSON as a complete override audit.

entries.explanation: Packing could not deliver a complete selected dependency closure.
likely_causes: Untrustworthy strict traversal, including unresolved, ambiguous or invalid dependency pointers
next_steps: Read missing, missing_links, errors, rewrites and publication/durability fields
Inspect the destination and pack-info before a new attempt
Do not deliver available members as a farm-ready complete package.

entries.explanation: The requested query contains unavailable field outcomes; independent saved rows and fields remain in stdout.
likely_causes: A requested saved field or semantic mapping is unavailable
A checked pointer, type or profile could not be qualified
next_steps: Retain the full JSON stdout despite exit 2
Inspect errors and each unavailable outcome's context and next_action
Run explain CONCEPT --file INPUT --json against the same input; do not substitute defaults

entries.explanation: The read batch retained independent item results but one or more planned reads failed; the terminal summary is incomplete.
likely_causes: A planned block, element, field path or array count could not be proved
A requests-document item names an unknown op, field or option
next_steps: Retain the full JSONL stdout despite exit 2; every observed item is retained in order with its index
Inspect each failed item's error, diagnostic_ref and next_command; verify its block/element/path against inspect on this exact input
Check the terminal summary counts, input/input_recheck and input_changed; a guard failure stops remaining requests as unobserved and outranks this aggregate

entries.explanation: Dependency traversal was not trustworthy enough to call complete; list may therefore withhold its listing.
next_steps: Run trace on the same input for typed per-site causes and owner chains
For read-only trace only, consider trace --non-strict for diagnostic collection while retaining complete:false/exit 2; pack remains strict
Do not interpret empty list stdout as no dependencies or use non-strict as a repair.

entries.explanation: A source signature or captured content no longer matches what the operation planned to read/copy.
likely_causes: Source changed between planning and publication
next_steps: Stop the competing writer or take a stable copy and plan again
Inspect any destination for published members before a new run
Do not retry repeatedly against a live changing source or weaken the guard.

entries.explanation: A saved blend block violates the container's structural rules.
likely_causes: Trailing decoded bytes or zero block code
next_steps: Verify the complete original transfer and compare a known-good copy
Try a compatible Blender read on a copy and retain its result
Do not ignore ENDB/trailing bytes or alter block sizes by hand.

entries.explanation: A dependency graph relationship violates the reader's required structure.
likely_causes: An unhandled valid native graph pattern
next_steps: Read the reported owner, field and specific invariant
Compare the same relationship in compatible Blender on a copy
Do not assume every graph refusal proves file corruption or an Oxblend bug.

entries.explanation: The decoded input does not contain a valid supported Blender header.
next_steps: Check file identity and transfer before deeper pointer diagnosis
Try an untouched original in compatible Blender
Do not rename an arbitrary file to .blend or patch header bytes.

entries.explanation: A saved record does not match the layout required for the operation.
likely_causes: ID header is opaque DATA or an array
next_steps: Inspect the reported record's code, count, SDNA type and extent
Keep the source and native-read result for triage
Do not coerce a DATA allocation into an ID or trust a type name alone.

entries.explanation: A requested saved projection lacks a required structural relationship, so its meaning cannot be certified.
likely_causes: A null required collection or object relationship
A view layer with an unsupported number of saved root layer collections
next_steps: Inspect the exact owner and saved relationship in the query context
Retain independent fields while treating this projection as unavailable
Do not guess a root, drop relationships or patch pointers to claim completion

entries.explanation: The saved DNA schema is structurally inconsistent or cannot be interpreted safely.
next_steps: Retain the original file and exact schema diagnostic
Verify the transfer and test a compatible Blender read on a copy
Do not patch DNA offsets or conclude all future Blender layouts are corrupt.

entries.explanation: An operating-system read, write, metadata or resource operation failed.
next_steps: Read the underlying OS message and identify which input/spec/temp/output operation failed
Check that exact path, mount, permissions, free space and process resource state
Do not change permissions broadly or rerun a publishing command before inspecting its destination.

entries.explanation: A library-facing JSON report could not be encoded.
likely_causes: Report serialization failed after data collection
next_steps: Retain the version and exact command plus the serialization message
Check whether stdout contains only a prefix
Do not confuse this output-encoding error with malformed edit-spec JSON.

entries.explanation: A constructor/import kit does not match the destination's DNA and container layout.
likely_causes: Different source Blender schema or header
next_steps: Use a qualified kit matching this destination's actual DNA/container
Perform the operation in Blender if no such kit exists
Do not copy structure bytes between schema versions.

entries.explanation: Trace could not open or read a referenced blend library.
next_steps: Use the reported library path and inspect its OS/decoder message
Read the library directly with a read-only command to recover its precise kind when safe
Do not rename this kind to library_reader or assume reader_kind is present in trace JSON.

entries.explanation: Override traversal could not read a referenced library and retains its underlying reader kind.
next_steps: Read reader_kind together with library_path and owner chain
Diagnose that underlying kind against the actual library, not the root file
Do not collapse this into trace's distinct library_read spelling.

entries.explanation: A node link or its endpoints do not belong to the required node tree/directions.
next_steps: Confirm both nodes and sockets belong to the intended tree with correct directions
Rebuild the link through Blender if ownership is unclear
Do not connect sockets by name alone across trees.

entries.explanation: The requested node-link operation is not qualified for this socket arrangement.
likely_causes: Multi-input socket semantics outside the supported profile
next_steps: Use Blender for multi-input link construction
Retain the socket type and requested connection for a feature request
Do not simulate ordering or fan-in by overwriting raw link pointers.

entries.explanation: The selected root-file ID is a linked reference, not an available local body.
likely_causes: A compound projection was requested from a linked ID stub
The root input does not store the library-owned content
next_steps: Preserve the linked identity and library reference
Open the owning library explicitly only when authorized
Do not treat a stub's absent body fields as false, zero or empty content

entries.explanation: A saved intrusive-list element's prev pointer is not its actual predecessor.
next_steps: Inspect the owner and adjacent elements from the exact saved list
Use Blender to validate/rebuild a copy
Do not silently follow only next and call the list structurally sound.

entries.explanation: An intrusive list's saved first/last boundaries disagree with its chain.
likely_causes: Final visited element differs from last
next_steps: Compare both endpoints and terminal next/prev links
Keep the owner field and endpoints for triage
Do not drop the last pointer or accept one-sided emptiness.

entries.explanation: A saved intrusive next-chain loops instead of terminating.
next_steps: Keep the owner field and first repeated address
Validate the corresponding list in Blender on a copy
Do not break an arbitrary edge or treat a cycle as an extra list element.

entries.explanation: An internal graph list's walked final element differs from its saved last endpoint.
likely_causes: Graph mutation left a stale last pointer
next_steps: Check the operation's before/after list and endpoint plan
Rebuild the list consistently through its owner
Do not change only the displayed count or ignore the terminal mismatch.

entries.explanation: A declared intrusive list lacks consistent nonnull endpoints or ends at a different last element.
likely_causes: Declared chain and last endpoint diverge
next_steps: Inspect both saved endpoints and the complete declared chain
Retain the source DNA/list role
Do not treat one reachable endpoint as proof of the whole list.

entries.explanation: A list element lacks the required next/prev intrusive header at its expected offsets.
next_steps: Check the element's SDNA and header offsets in inspect
Use native Blender for the list if its role is unqualified
Do not assume every structure begins with next and prev.

entries.explanation: A source-list walk failed its combined cycle, symmetry or endpoint checks.
next_steps: Read the specific source-list message and inspect adjacent saved records
Preserve the original before native repair
Do not use a partial traversal as a complete ordered list.

entries.explanation: A declared intrusive list's backward edge does not reciprocate the walked next edge.
next_steps: Compare the previous/current records and both edge directions
Keep the owning list role with the report
Do not accept forward reachability alone as proof of reciprocity.

entries.explanation: A graph list element's prev edge disagrees with its predecessor.
likely_causes: A graph mutation updated only one direction
next_steps: Review the operation that inserted/removed the element and rebuild both links
Use owner-managed list construction
Do not patch one edge without rechecking first/last and the full chain.

entries.explanation: The requested diagnostic address is null or absent in this exact input.
next_steps: Use inspect/blocks on this exact file to choose an existing address
Check decimal versus 0x hexadecimal input
Do not treat an old address as a persistent data-block identifier.

entries.explanation: A declared external asset has no available required file/member at its resolved location.
next_steps: Use the usage owner's resolved path, not the shell working directory
Restore/repath the actual asset and check required tiles/frames independently
Do not treat one glob match as complete frame/tile coverage or a partial pack as complete.

entries.explanation: The selected saved structure has no field with the requested name.
likely_causes: A higher-level command assumes a field unavailable in this layout
next_steps: Inspect this exact file's SDNA and selected block before changing the query
For source-facts/library-facts use trace for dependency questions
Do not add a missing field to DNA or assume it means a lost external asset.

entries.explanation: The library file exists but does not contain the linked data-block requested by saved ID code/name.
next_steps: Inspect root, library, saved ID code/name and referencing owner chain
Restore the intended library revision or repair the link in Blender
Do not report this as a missing physical file or assume an available-member pack is complete.

entries.explanation: A selected input blend file is missing or not an eligible file.
next_steps: Check the exact native-byte input path and mount
Select the intended regular file
Do not diagnose pointer/schema defects before the input exists.

entries.explanation: A referenced external blend library cannot be found at its resolved location.
likely_causes: Relative library path resolved from the wrong expected owner
next_steps: Use the declared owner and library path from trace to locate the missing file
Restore or repath it in Blender and trace again
Do not infer the unknown contents of an absent library from available listings.

entries.explanation: A new graph node/socket name is already used where uniqueness is required.
likely_causes: Existing node/output with the proposed name
next_steps: Inspect existing names in the intended tree/owner and choose a deliberate distinct name
Use Blender if the operation really means replace an existing item
Do not silently overwrite or auto-rename identity-bearing names.

entries.explanation: No qualified native prototype is available for the requested node kind.
likely_causes: Constructor kit lacks a matching prototype
next_steps: Check the exact node kind rather than its display label
Create the node in Blender or request qualified constructor support
Do not instantiate an unknown node from a generic zeroed structure.

entries.explanation: The requested node is not a member of the selected tree.
next_steps: Read the tree's saved node list and select its actual member
Rebuild the operation plan from that tree
Do not remove or mutate a node through an unrelated owner.

entries.explanation: The staged compressed output failed its decoder verification.
next_steps: Retain input, compression choice and verification message
Check underlying io separately if it is reported instead
Do not publish or deliver an output whose compressed readback failed.

entries.explanation: Decoding the staged output produced a length different from the immutable decoded source body.
likely_causes: Re-encoding changed/truncated the logical byte stream
next_steps: Keep the input and edit plan for a reproducible writer report
Verify storage health before attributing the cause
Do not accept a shorter/longer output because the intended field looks correct.

entries.explanation: A no-replace output path already exists or appeared during publication.
next_steps: Inspect and preserve the existing destination
Choose a fresh output path after checking partial effects
Do not delete or overwrite existing work automatically.

entries.explanation: The chosen output filename/parent is invalid or reserved for staging.
next_steps: Choose a normal new basename under a real writable directory
Check exact path bytes and reported stage state
Do not use reserved staging names or treat an existing non-directory as a parent.

entries.explanation: A checked length, offset, count or address calculation exceeds its representable width.
likely_causes: Input exceeds a supported integer representation
next_steps: Keep the exact arithmetic context and source dimensions
Check the input layout rather than guessing a smaller value
Do not wrap, clamp or truncate the calculation to continue.

entries.explanation: A block cannot be qualified as the native ID/USER owner its header claims.
next_steps: Inspect BHead code, SDNA type, count and ID name prefix together
Distinguish unsupported versions from contradictory headers
Do not rely on the two-letter code alone for write admission.

entries.explanation: The emitted graph's re-read owner mapping differs from its planned owner mapping.
likely_causes: Imported records placed under the wrong owner
next_steps: Keep the operation plan and decoded output diagnostic
Report the owner mismatch as an invariant failure
Do not accept pointer closure alone as proof of correct ownership.

entries.explanation: Different planned members or generated pack files occupy the same final path.
likely_causes: A required asset is named pack-info.txt
next_steps: Review dry-run destination mappings and consider --keep-hierarchy or a better project root
Choose a layout preserving both sources
Do not overwrite one source with another or drop a required member.

entries.explanation: The destination is not eligible for a safe new pack.
likely_causes: Destination alters a required source sequence/directory namespace
next_steps: Use a fresh destination outside required source namespaces
Inspect any partial package before planning again
Do not merge into or resume a nonempty package.

entries.explanation: The selected pack/list/blocks input does not exist as an eligible file.
next_steps: Check the actual input path and regular-file status
Restore the intended source before retrying
Do not create an empty .blend merely to satisfy the path check.

entries.explanation: A traced path cannot be matched to its checked saved owner and field for relocation.
next_steps: Keep the trace usage and exact source hash and field metadata
Use Blender for relocation if no qualified saved origin exists
Do not write a guessed offset or treat a dependency string as write permission.

entries.explanation: A pack source or destination path violates the safe path policy.
next_steps: Read the exact path-policy message and inspect the affected member type
Choose a safe regular-file source/destination layout
Do not bypass containment or follow an unsafe output symlink.

entries.explanation: The explicit project directory cannot be selected because it does not exist.
next_steps: Choose an existing project directory containing the selected roots lexically
Use a dry-run to confirm resulting destinations
Do not create a random root merely to silence the error.

entries.explanation: A typed edit targets serialized padding rather than an admitted semantic leaf.
likely_causes: Byte-offset edit disguised as a typed value
next_steps: Select the actual intended typed field from SDNA
Use Blender for operations with no admitted leaf
Do not write padding or treat it as spare user storage.

entries.explanation: The field-selection path is malformed or cannot be traversed as written.
next_steps: Use field strings and nonnegative indices for get/pointer, and the command's own edit-path format for specs
Consult COMMAND --help and inspect SDNA
Do not confuse a field path with a filesystem path.

entries.explanation: Path rewriting cannot safely establish the required contextual import-input list.
next_steps: Inspect the owning import node and its inputs in Blender on a copy
Keep the contextual list diagnostic
Do not rewrite a contextual path by guessing the owner or breaking the list cycle.

entries.explanation: A rewrite path contains an embedded NUL byte.
likely_causes: A string terminator included inside expected/replacement path bytes
next_steps: Supply path content bytes without an embedded terminator
Let the writer add the bounded terminator
Do not hide bytes after NUL or treat them as part of a valid pathname.

entries.explanation: The replacement path plus its terminator does not fit the fixed saved field.
likely_causes: Destination path longer than actual char-array capacity
next_steps: Choose a deliberately shorter valid destination/layout or repath in Blender
Check capacity from the exact source
Do not truncate the replacement or enlarge the field by patching DNA.

entries.explanation: The saved path spelling is known but its resolution has not been verified.
likely_causes: Owning file or linked-library context is unavailable
next_steps: Retain the saved spelling
Verify the owning blend context before resolving relative paths

entries.explanation: The old fixed-width path has no NUL terminator inside its saved capacity.
likely_causes: Malformed or fully filled nonterminated field
next_steps: Read raw field bytes and actual SDNA capacity
Use Blender to validate/resave a copy if appropriate
Do not scan into the next field looking for a terminator.

entries.explanation: The saved image pattern is known, but its complete required member set could not be proved.
likely_causes: Unavailable tile list or unsupported tile filename token
No associated saved ImageUser span, nonpositive duration, negative offset/current frame, unavailable refresh/current state or nonnumeric sequence filename
next_steps: Inspect trace pattern_status, pattern_unknown and expected_members
Verify the saved tile or playback declaration in compatible Blender on a copy
Use --permissive only for an explicitly INCOMPLETE package; do not infer completeness from existing glob matches

entries.explanation: The pointed record count does not satisfy its role's required count.
likely_causes: Array where one typed record is required
next_steps: Compare target count, code and role using inspect
Check whether the source layout is supported before treating it as corruption
Do not change count to one without validating the complete allocation.

entries.explanation: A pointer-table entry was requested from a field that is not pointer-to-pointer.
likely_causes: Single pointer mistaken for a pointer table
next_steps: Inspect the field declaration and use ordinary pointer resolution when appropriate
Select a table entry only for an actual double pointer
Do not reinterpret arbitrary addresses as pointer tables.

entries.explanation: A pointer target's allocation size/count/length does not match its qualified role.
likely_causes: Saved array length or preview dimensions disagree with storage
next_steps: Read the owning role and its saved length/discriminator plus the target's code/count/size
Preserve exact extents for triage
Do not clip a buffer, assume count=1, or clear a target to force acceptance.

entries.explanation: A field path attempts to walk through a pointer implicitly.
likely_causes: Nested path crosses a pointer boundary
next_steps: Run pointer on the source field, then query the returned target explicitly
Keep target indices tied to the same saved file
Do not append fields through an unchecked pointer in get.

entries.explanation: An emitted graph still has unresolved or ambiguous pointers on re-read.
likely_causes: Graph relocation omitted or misdirected an edge
next_steps: Keep the operation plan and output census details
Report the failed structural proof rather than shipping the graph
Do not call semantic_verified:false a native reconstruction certificate.

entries.explanation: The pointer's declared owner/field/discriminator cannot be interpreted as the required role.
next_steps: Inspect the source DNA and reported owning role, including discriminator bytes
Use Blender for unsupported interpretation
Do not infer pointer meaning solely from a nonzero address.

entries.explanation: A pointer resolved, but its target is not the type/storage family required by the owning role.
likely_causes: ID header where owner-local DATA is required
Wrong node storage or list element type
next_steps: Inspect the target code, SDNA, count and source discriminator together
For facts-only refusals use trace for dependency questions
Do not cast the target to the expected type or mistake resolution for validation.

entries.explanation: The requested operation would write a pointer or pointer-backed path outside admitted repairs.
likely_causes: Pack needs relocation of a pointer-backed selected path
next_steps: Use Blender for arbitrary pointer changes or unsupported relocations
Read pack warnings to distinguish unselected preserved paths from selected relocation failures
Do not zero pointers or reuse narrow qualified library clears as a general setter.

entries.explanation: The requested compositing edit does not match the qualified reader/Image discriminator.
likely_causes: ImageUser is not a qualified compositor Image reader
next_steps: Inspect the actual node idname, owner, Image source and stored reader state
Use Blender if the requested reader is outside the profile
Do not rename fields/nodes or change discriminators solely to gain admission.

entries.explanation: The field/value/index selection has no admitted compositing profile.
likely_causes: Replacement outside that field's qualified range
next_steps: Check the exact qualified fields and values in the source profile and USAGE
Use Blender for unsupported changes
Do not switch to format-only and claim compositing semantics were verified.

entries.explanation: Library retargeting cannot prove an admitted equivalent-content relocation.
next_steps: Compare the actual old/new library content and stable source state
Use Blender to relink/recompile when content changes
Do not substitute a same-named but different library or claim this profile supports packed libraries.

entries.explanation: The compositing target is linked or override-protected rather than an editable local owner.
next_steps: Edit the source library or use Blender's appropriate override workflow
Confirm owner locality before regenerating a spec
Do not flip linked/override flags to bypass protection.

entries.explanation: Masked flag writes are not admitted in compositing-profile mode.
next_steps: Use format-only only when raw persistent bit editing is genuinely intended and independently validated
Use Blender for a semantic comp flag change
Do not treat a mode change as semantic qualification.

entries.explanation: The comp edit is not owned by a qualified local Scene, Image or node owner.
next_steps: Inspect the owning ID, not just the leaf structure
Use Blender for other owner families
Do not move a record into an admitted owner to evade the guard.

entries.explanation: The final edited Scene/reader timing is inconsistent with the qualified temporal profile.
likely_causes: ImageUser has no active compositor Scene
next_steps: Review the complete final Scene and reader timing together
Make one coherent guarded plan or change it in Blender
Do not validate each frame field in isolation or assume saved timing proves evaluated animation.

entries.explanation: A custom-property group already contains the proposed property name.
likely_causes: Imported property collides with an existing sibling
next_steps: Inspect exact saved name bytes in the target group
Choose deliberate replace/rename behavior in Blender if needed
Do not silently overwrite a sibling property.

entries.explanation: A custom property is not detached and owner-local to its intended group.
next_steps: Check property/group owners and next/prev before insertion
Use native property APIs for cross-owner copying
Do not attach one saved record to multiple groups.

entries.explanation: The custom-property operation did not select exactly one property.
next_steps: Inspect group names and narrow the selection to one actual property
Confirm exact byte identity
Do not remove the first matching sibling arbitrarily.

entries.explanation: A custom-property group operation received a nongroup IDProperty.
likely_causes: Scalar/array property selected as a group
next_steps: Inspect the property's saved type and select the containing group
Use Blender to convert/rebuild intentionally
Do not reinterpret scalar union bytes as a group list.

entries.explanation: A saved query structure revisits an identity where an acyclic list or tree is required.
likely_causes: A cyclic saved list or hierarchy
next_steps: Inspect the exact owner, field and pointer site in the unavailable outcome
Retain independent query outcomes and mark this projection incomplete
Do not truncate the cycle or patch pointers to claim completion

entries.explanation: A saved list's previous/next/end controls disagree, so its complete ordered content cannot be certified.
likely_causes: A last pointer that does not match the traversed end
next_steps: Inspect both saved ListBase ends and the reported record links
Keep independent rows, but do not treat the traversed prefix as a complete list
Diagnose without pointer repair; use a known-good save or a separately authorized native repair

entries.explanation: Raw-allocation admission was requested for a typed rather than opaque allocation.
likely_causes: Typed DATA supplied where opaque bytes are required
next_steps: Inspect the target's SDNA/index and actual role
Use the qualified typed path or Blender instead
Do not erase type metadata to make an allocation appear opaque.

entries.explanation: A typed record's count and per-record size do not equal its allocation extent.
likely_causes: Constructor plan supplied inconsistent new data
next_steps: Compare count times source SDNA size with the payload size
For new graph data rebuild the constructor request
Do not discard surplus bytes or alter counts until the mismatch is understood.

entries.explanation: A pointer required by its qualified role is NULL.
next_steps: Inspect the source discriminator and required target role
Validate native behavior on a copy
Do not fabricate a target or treat all NULL fields as missing dependencies.

entries.explanation: A graph operation removes a record still referenced by a kept record.
next_steps: Review kept versus removed sets and all incoming edges
Use Blender for a qualified unlink/delete if needed
Do not emit dangling edges by ignoring the retained reference.

entries.explanation: A planned Render Layers source edge is not actually a Scene reference.
next_steps: Inspect the Render Layers node's saved ID and intended Scene
Regenerate the graph plan for this input
Do not retarget an unrelated ID as though it were a Scene.

entries.explanation: The output aliases the original input, so no-replace editing is refused.
next_steps: Choose a genuinely new output path and preserve the original
Check inode identity as well as path spelling
Do not unlink/rename the input to trick the no-replace check.

entries.explanation: A compressed seek-table/framing proof is absent or inconsistent.
next_steps: Read accompanying fallback diagnostics and the final command outcome
Use the full decoder path when Oxblend chooses it and retain any eventual underlying error
Do not treat a successful fallback warning as a hard command failure or patch seek offsets.

entries.explanation: The typed-edit report could not be serialized for stdout.
next_steps: Retain the exact command, report error and destination publication evidence
Inspect the destination before any retry
Do not assume failed report delivery means the edit had no effect.

entries.explanation: The diagnostic SHA-256 length accounting exceeded its representable message width.
likely_causes: An input length cannot fit the hash message/bit-length representation
next_steps: Check the actual file size and the exact overflow message
Use a suitable independent hashing tool if that narrow question is needed
Do not truncate the file or call a partial hash the full input identity.

entries.explanation: A field reference or edit plan belongs to a different immutable snapshot.
likely_causes: Mixing API objects from separate captures
Reusing a plan with a newly opened input
next_steps: Build field references and plan from one snapshot and write that plan against its owner
Recapture intentionally if the input changes
Do not reuse physical offsets across snapshots.

entries.explanation: No qualified native socket/default/pass-storage construction matches this request.
likely_causes: Unqualified vector dimensions or pass metadata version
next_steps: Inspect the requested socket kind, dimensions and saved pass metadata version
Use Blender to build unsupported sockets
Do not invent default storage or truncate a pass identity/index.

entries.explanation: A socket is not owned by the required node and direction.
likely_causes: Selected owner is not a node
next_steps: Confirm node membership and socket direction from the actual lists
Rebuild the operation using the correct owner
Do not reuse a socket record across nodes.

entries.explanation: The live read backing changed identity or content during a scan.
next_steps: Read a stable copy or stop the competing writer before scanning again
Keep the original scan failure with the source signature
Do not trust a report assembled across changing file versions.

entries.explanation: There is not enough available temporary filesystem space for the required decoded spill.
likely_causes: Compressed input expands beyond available temp capacity
next_steps: Check the reported required/available/shortfall bytes and the actual temp filesystem
Provide a temp location with sufficient space before another run
Do not treat --low-memory as a disk/memory ceiling or delete unrelated temporary work.

entries.explanation: A node storage layout lacks the schema facts required by its qualified graph profile.
likely_causes: Missing node schema or panel-count field
next_steps: Inspect the owning node kind/version and storage schema
Use Blender for the unsupported structural operation
Do not guess the storage extent from a neighboring node.

entries.explanation: An owner-local DATA block appears outside a qualified ID/USER run.
next_steps: Inspect surrounding ordered block headers and qualified owner
Use Blender to validate a separate copy
Do not attach the stray block to the nearest convenient ID.

entries.explanation: A typed CString replacement contains an embedded NUL.
next_steps: Supply CString content without an embedded terminator
Use exact-width bytes only when that separate operation is intended and admitted
Do not hide trailing content behind NUL.

entries.explanation: An old or planned fixed char string has no bounded terminator.
likely_causes: Library path replacement lacks NUL in its fixed field
next_steps: Read the raw fixed-width bytes and source capacity
Use Blender to validate/resave the string when appropriate
Do not search beyond the field or append bytes into adjacent storage.

entries.explanation: The constructor kit has no qualified Text prototype to import.
next_steps: Create the Text in Blender or use a qualified matching kit
Keep source schema and requested operation for a feature request
Do not synthesize a Text block from guessed fields.

entries.explanation: The input or backing data ends before a required header, field, payload or copy extent.
next_steps: Compare source size/hash with the original and check concurrent writers
Recover an intact copy before further analysis
Do not pad the file with zeros or treat a partial read as complete.

entries.explanation: The selected value is not the kind the operation expects.
likely_causes: pointer used on a nonpointer field
next_steps: Inspect this exact field's SDNA and tagged get value
Use the correct query or a native tool for an unhandled layout
Do not cast the bytes to the desired kind simply because their width matches.

entries.explanation: A typed-edit value tag does not exactly match the saved primitive or whole-array kind.
likely_causes: CString used on something other than a whole char array
next_steps: Read SDNA type and construct the correct strict typed value
Keep exact float bits when needed
Do not coerce signedness or reinterpret one primitive as another.

entries.explanation: A typed replacement cannot fit the saved integer or string capacity.
next_steps: Check the actual type width/capacity and choose a representable intended value
Use Blender when structural resizing is required
Do not wrap integers or truncate strings.

entries.explanation: The declared type/width/array shape does not exactly match saved storage.
next_steps: Derive exact type, total width and dimensions from inspect
Supply the entire admitted array/char field where required
Do not guess widths from host architecture or silently pad/truncate values.

entries.explanation: The exact name is neither an authored catalog concept nor an actual type in the selected file's SDNA.
likely_causes: A file-specific SDNA type requested without the file
next_steps: Run catalog --json for exact concept names and aliases
Inspect INPUT for exact saved type names
Run explain TYPE --file INPUT --json; names are not fuzzy matched

entries.explanation: Oxblend has no qualified interpretation for this saved pointer/list/storage role or discriminator.
next_steps: Keep owner type, field, discriminator and saved Blender version for a focused support request
Use Blender for the unsupported dependency/structural question
Do not ignore the role, assume a void pointer is arbitrary, or weaken traversal to claim completeness.

entries.explanation: A persistent saved pointer has no target in the required namespace/owner context.
next_steps: Keep the source block, field, address and namespace context
Compare pointer-census and native behavior on a copy
Do not confuse runtime/cache exclusions with permission to drop persistent edges.

entries.explanation: Path rewrite is not an arbitrary setter and this target is outside its whitelist.
likely_causes: Not a whole fixed char array
next_steps: Use Blender for renames or unsupported field changes
Use rewrite only for its admitted literal filepath fields
Do not rename a data-block by rewriting ID.name bytes.

entries.explanation: The container/header variant is not a supported Blender serialization format.
next_steps: Keep the header bytes and creating Blender version for triage
Use compatible Blender to save a separate supported copy if appropriate
Do not rewrite the format marker to masquerade as supported.

entries.explanation: The selected record/field is outside this operation's supported typed interpretation.
likely_causes: DNA1 metadata queried as a record
ID outside the narrow facts closure
next_steps: Inspect the actual selected type and use a suitable read-only operation
For source-facts/library-facts dependency questions fall back to trace
Do not assume the whole file is unsupported or cast metadata into scene values.

entries.explanation: The requested saved-fact semantic projection has not been qualified for this representation.
likely_causes: A semantic profile is not enabled
SDNA field presence alone does not establish its version-specific meaning
next_steps: Run explain CONCEPT --file INPUT --json
Use exact raw query/get/pointer inspection when needed
Keep unsupported facts unavailable; do not infer Blender defaults or current-version meanings

entries.explanation: The command arguments, option values or argument count do not match the CLI contract.
likely_causes: Unknown memory mode, or a pack memory mode differing from the Session's opened retention policy
next_steps: Run oxblend COMMAND --help offline and compare the exact argv
Keep structured next_command arguments as data rather than shell text

For pack memory pressure (#33), fast (default) uses signature-bound selective raw windows for raw blends, reading only needed raw ranges without retaining whole decoded sources on that path. Compressed blends fall back to full decoded capture; Python Sessions retain captured sources as before. Selected workload measurements showed 27-53% lower fast heap; this is not a universal memory or timing guarantee. Opt in to --memory bounded for additional source re-reads, lower peak memory and slower runs; this is a retention policy, not a hard RAM ceiling.
Do not retry writes automatically from a suggestion.

entries.explanation: A ZIP member name cannot be represented in the writer's required UTF-8 encoding.
likely_causes: Native Unix filename contains non-UTF-8 bytes
next_steps: Use a directory package when supported for the same source set
Choose a deliberate byte-preserving transfer workflow
Do not replace filename bytes silently or claim a lossy ZIP is equivalent.

entries.explanation: A ZIP member would escape the workspace or has unsafe path components.
next_steps: Review staged member mapping and select a contained safe layout
Keep virtual archive paths distinct from filesystem paths
Do not strip traversal components silently or extract an unsafe member.

entries.explanation: A ZIP member name exceeds the format field used by this writer.
likely_causes: Encoded member name longer than the ZIP u16 name-length field
next_steps: Shorten the intended hierarchy/names or choose a directory package
Check encoded byte length rather than display character count
Do not truncate names or imply ZIP64 enlarges this filename field.
